texts: A field engineer records a voltage measurement, its unit, the sensor location, and the time. Explain how another engineer can repeat this measurement and compare the two observations.
A laboratory runs the same calculation several times. The first run is slower than later runs. Describe what should be recorded before drawing a conclusion about the cause.
A device receives four short requests one after another. Explain the difference between the time until the first visible output and the time until the entire response is complete.
Two language models answer the same short question. Their tokenizers split the text differently. Explain why both the text and the actual token counts should be retained in a performance report.
